description: Extracts structured country profiles from The World Factbook (theworldfactbook.org),  including geography, population, government, economy, energy, communications,  transportation, military, and transnational issues data.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_profile: 获取完整或部分国家档案;需要country参数，可选section/keys/max_items过滤; 参数: country, section, keys, max_items; 必填: country
  - search_key: 按关键词搜索国家数据;需要country和search_term参数; 参数: country, search_term; 必填: country, search_term
  - list_sections: 列出国家的所有数据分类及条目数;需要country参数; 参数: country; 必填: country
  - get_summary: 获取国家关键事实摘要;需要country参数; 参数: country; 必填: country

section.description:
数据分类过滤，用于get_profile。可用值如 "geography", "economy", 
"people and society", "government", "military and security" 等

keys.description:
关键词过滤列表，用于get_profile。如 ["population", "area", "GDP"] 
将只返回包含这些关键词的数据项

max_items.description: 每个分类返回的最大数据项数，用于get_profile限制输出大小

search_term.description: 搜索关键词，用于search_key功能。将搜索所有数据项的键名匹配项
